rows.title: persistent BackboneState pattern
rows.notes: A large stored actor schema is not proof of historical formation or situated integration; fields conflate durable, derived and surface projections.

rows.title: material capacity
rows.notes: Annually adjusting time/money/health/support cannot model care's real availability or changing feasible participation at event/interval scales.

rows.title: psychological/regulatory capacity vector
rows.notes: Vitality/aperture/binding/agency scalars risk becoming one cause for many different kinds of regulation and developmental competence.

rows.title: reproduction constraints
rows.notes: Debt/dependents/care/jobbing data constrain actual life without yielding direct subjective distress, defensiveness or attachment outcome.

rows.title: A/S/V/Aim domains and latent/expressed Aim
rows.notes: A/S/V/Aim grouped domains may be useful projections but cannot be universal causal compartments or a single winning channel.

rows.title: multidimensional alienation
rows.notes: A predeclared alienation vector risks assuming historically particular estrangement from social location; old delta path has stale field names.

rows.title: public/private/inner registers
rows.notes: Public/private/inner registers describe accessibility and expression, not the total unconscious, memory or causal source.

rows.title: wound/sensitivity state
rows.notes: Wound preset from identity treats sensitive histories as inherited demographic characteristics; shame/fear are not automatic trait axes.

rows.title: cracks
rows.notes: Automatically ensuring a minimum crack count invents personality pathology; 'crack' can confound tension, contradiction, fragmentation and situation.

rows.title: buffers and costs
rows.notes: Buffer strength/cost updates are informative but absent detailed source about whose care or practical activity makes regulation possible.

rows.title: frameworks as metabolic operators
rows.notes: Frameworks as acute/chronic metabolic operators are useful, but generic 'framework weights' cannot stand in for acquired concepts, morality or theology.

rows.title: collective infrastructure
rows.notes: Collective support networks cannot be an autonomous internal psyche bonus; actual institutions, oppression, presence and solidarity matter.

rows.title: practice stack
rows.notes: A categorical study/care/risk practice stack can update numerically without the actual acquisition, repetition and support of activities.

rows.title: PeakRouting / loop topology / solidarity boundary
rows.notes: Three legacy loop labels and year counters capture hysteresis, not the space of dynamically reorganizing interdependent motivations.

rows.title: need axes / expectation baseline
rows.notes: Ten need axes and four baseline labels are real, but unknown parent becomes 50/50/50 and all needs begin 'hopeful'; flat labels cannot represent thick contradictory baselines.

rows.title: StrivingObject
rows.notes: Persistent striving objects hold investment and momentum, but 'spawn for age' risks adult/child goals from chronological stage rather than lived activity.

rows.title: Gift/Disruption shards / expectation events
rows.notes: Gift/disruption shards represent predicted satisfaction or violation but can pre-classify impression as reward/wound.

rows.title: RuptureShard
rows.notes: Epistemic rupture is more specific than negative affect, and a discrepant episode need not be 'rupture'.

rows.title: multi-year MetabolizationProcess
rows.notes: Multi-year statuses and plasticity are useful temporal memory but preselected modes can install a deterministic universal 'assimilation/accommodation' path.

rows.title: magnets / relational field
rows.notes: Persistent magnets toward people/institutions plus structural field projection are different causal jurisdictions; magnet cannot be mysterious attractiveness score.

rows.title: pressure-flow history / memory / grooves / conductance
rows.notes: Charge conservation, route selection and grooves implement real coupled bookkeeping but suggest an unwarranted conserved psychological substance and fixed primary channels.

rows.title: child model / assumed rules / taboos / possible-world boundary
rows.notes: Assumed rules and taboos exist, but a child's early practical/bodily anticipations precede articulable cultural categories.

rows.title: autonomy/safety drives and conditions
rows.notes: Autonomy/safety drives and micro drift are present; universal seeded values or default time increments obscure actual safety relations and material dependence.

rows.title: stability-threshold inertia
rows.notes: Year-bound hysteresis is a computational approximation of persistence, not science about when one event can reorganize life.

rows.title: yearly ordered causal spine
rows.notes: 19-step immutable yearly ordering preserves consistency but a year is the wrong single causal unit for baby encounters, ordinary routine and batch recursions.

rows.title: stored-versus-derived separation
rows.notes: Derived quantities must not masquerade as stored causal truths; this is broadly compatible.

rows.title: Pass 1 LLM proposal
rows.notes: LLM-proposed events are meaningful, but previous events contain code-applied deltas which may write psychological result before person computation.

rows.title: score/select/apply boundary
rows.notes: Scoring/surprise random sampling could impose thematic drama, preordained impacts and missing no-event outcomes; old selector lacks hard admissibility.

rows.title: Pass 2 render-only role
rows.notes: Render-only hash-preservation is good, but new post-batch retrospective LLM can articulate self-meaning that potentially becomes future causal activity.

rows.title: V3-under-V2 nonmutation architecture
rows.notes: V3 causal state and V2 expression must remain one person; a second narrating psyche would violate that.

rows.title: life-course Enneagram emergence / end matcher
rows.notes: Retrospective typology and inferred parent-type impacts risk personality being imposed by type from the start.

rows.title: old V5 runtime-input / field-injection bridge
rows.notes: Old V5 bridge identity and projection are obsolete while inert signed-input carrier/gating are useful.

rows.title: generic pseudo-random mechanical event sampler
rows.notes: Generic pseudo-random event/delta generator cannot simulate contingent ordinary activity, other persons or the formation of needs and expectations.

rows.title: fallback concretization when Pass 1/selection yields nothing
rows.notes: When LLM proposal absent, the old runtime manufactures practice events so a 'person' still appears to develop.

rows.title: placeholder crack/framework invariant repair
rows.notes: Framework/crack placeholder injection manufactures internal content to satisfy invariants.

rows.title: hopeful/medium parent defaults
rows.notes: Unknown parent behavior initializes middle values and hopeful baselines.

rows.title: structural placeholder scene / annotation for non-LLM years
rows.notes: Structural year stubs are already quarantined, but a fully realistic life cannot be only selected dramatic episodes.

rows.title: dual derived-schedule declaration
rows.notes: Repeated derived-schedule surfaces are already checked for consistency, which limits drift.

rows.title: server-side/manual rupture injection
rows.notes: Age-band injection produces ruptures outside the event ledger using uncontrolled random calls.

rows.title: generation readiness / global ready surface
rows.notes: Clean/degraded/blocked generation-integrity system is real; simplistic ready-flag criticism is stale.
